name: PIXMA TS5050
measure_description: Profile created from a Powercalc Measure recording (measure app 0.14.3, Shelly Plug S Gen3, 230 V). One run over 64 minutes with 1857 samples: 1712 idle and 56 printing. Idle shows two reachable levels (about 1.1 W in deep sleep, about 3.7 W awake on WiFi), so the energy-weighted average is used. Printing averages 10.8 W (median 11.6 W, peak 19.2 W). The measured unit is a PIXMA TS5050 (GTIN 4549292066517); IPP only discloses "TS5000 series", which is why the profile is registered under the TS5050 directory and keeps "TS5000 series" as the discovery alias.
